title: HOTAS Side-Stick & Throttles
summary: Hands-On-Throttle-And-Stick (HOTAS) layout with right-hand force-sensing side-stick and left-hand dual engine throttles.
role: Allows the pilot to command flight control surfaces, thrust vectoring, and twin F119 engines without removing hands from primary controls.
